After only

Scoreboard, Activity, and Badges had no matched before. Roster related links sit below the fold, so the list viewport matched the baseline byte-for-byte and is omitted. Availability was not captured because this Admin profile is not Student-scheduling-class.

What changed, and why

The header is identity, Scoreboard is a jump

Was

Role, email, and the 0–1 record competed with the Scoreboard tab.

Now

Status is role/affiliation/inactive. Subtitle is title or student year. Area, location, and reports-to sit with a Scoreboard CTA.

Info is Contact, Work, and Assignments

Was

One Details dump. Slack lived only in Settings. Empty Collaborator affiliation looked like a missing field.

Now

On-page jumps. Slack handle and Slack profile are on Contact. Affiliation copy says it is only needed for Collaborator. Hours stay visible with retry.

Filters and fields hit 40px

Was

Activity chips were 24–28px. Availability inputs were 32px. Size and birthday selects used sm triggers.

Now

Activity, Availability, and Badges filters and Info fields use 40px targets. Related jumps sit under roster and profile.

Verification

  • Focused source tests: users-profile-overhaul-source, user-profile-annotations, user-profile-phone-fields, users-sweeping-ui-contract, user-detail-location-options-state, operator-qol.
  • npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false passed.
  • eslint on changed Users files passed.
  • Authenticated Preview as ADMIN Erik Role at 127.0.0.1:3000. Info loaded Contact/Work/Assignments, Slack fields, Scoreboard jump, Hours jump to #hours. Scoreboard, Activity (Account filter focused), and Badges tabs loaded. Roster related links: Org chart, Onboarding status, Team Scoreboard, Schedule.
  • npm run build:app was not run because Preview next dev owns port 3000.
  • Availability tab not exercised in browser; this profile is not ST. AppLayout hydration overlay is pre-existing page-chrome work, not this slice.

Things to know

  • Tab URLs, role gates, and collaborator minimized profiles are unchanged.
  • Proof contains live campus contact data and should stay private in the archive.
